description: This PHP class defines a validator for the HTML ID attribute within the HTMLPurifier library. It handles validation rules such as prefixing, uniqueness, and character restrictions for HTML IDs, optionally tailored for CSS selector contexts.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_ID
classes.description: A class that validates an HTML ID attribute value, with considerations for CSS selectors, prefixes, blacklist patterns, and uniqueness within document context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator, optionally indicating if it operates within a CSS selector context.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given ID string based on configuration and context rules, including prefix application, character checks, and blacklist pattern matching. Returns either the validated ID or false if invalid.
